Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and restricted
cervical range of motion. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Cervical strain was
diagnosed, and conservative management was initiated, including manual therapy, stretching, home exercise instruction, and
as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. Over 18 visits, treatment followed a typical clinical course, with frequency tapering as
symptoms gradually resolved and function improved. Examination findings included paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced
rotation, which support the diagnosis, while neurological screening and imaging-related findings were within normal limits. No
prior injury or ongoing complaints involving the cervical spine are known to this provider. Two similar charges submitted on the
same date of service are currently under administrative review to confirm they reflect separate, documented services. Patient was
discharged from active care with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
